reserve_profile.summary: Bridge states Open Issuance custom stablecoins are always backed 1:1 by equivalent USD value, with reserves managed in cash and U.S. Treasuries. Exact DLUSD allocation is not published in the reviewed sources.

redemption_profile.eligible_parties: Eligible Deel contractors can move their DLUSD wallet balance back to Deel balance for USD value; exact direct Bridge redemption eligibility is not established here.
redemption_profile.fee_text: Deel states movement back to Deel balance is available without costs; direct Bridge redemption fees are not established here.
redemption_profile.settlement_time_text: Deel describes movement back to Deel balance as instant; direct Bridge redemption timing is not established.
